statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); dir=; [ -n "$current_dir" ] && dir=$(basename "$current_dir"); git_status=; [ -n "$current_dir" ] && git_status=$(cd "$current_dir" && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null && echo "[$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)]$(git diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || echo "*")$(git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null || echo "+")" 2>/dev/null); status=; [ -n "$model" ] && status=$(printf '\033[0;35m%s\033[0m' "$model"); [ -n "$used" ] && context_text=$(printf '%.0f%%' "$used") && status="$status  \033[0;33m${context_text}\033[0m"; [ -n "$dir" ] && status="$status  \033[0;36m${dir}\033[0m"; [ -n "$git_status" ] && status="$status  \033[0;32m${git_status}\033[0m"; printf "%b" "$status"
